with_social.description: Modo compacto CON estado social — mínimo consumo de tokens, alta precisión. Usa {clip}/{id_map}/{example}/{keys}.
with_social.template:
{clip}. Map: {id_map}.
Keys: {keys}. JSON: {{{example}}}
Per ID:
- 'a': max 2 words, the SPECIFIC real thing they're doing/attending to right now (e.g. 'eating', 'using phone', 'watching camera', 'reading', 'walking'), not a generic category. If legs are visible, prefix posture: 'sit'/'stand' + behavior (e.g. 'sit eating', 'stand talking'). If legs are NOT visible (close-up, only torso/face in frame), no posture prefix — just the behavior. Judge EACH person independently, even in a group.
- 's': A(idle/not focused) T(facing camera) B(phone/reading/solo task) E(talking with someone) M(walking/moving).
- 'T' only if the face clearly points at the camera; otherwise 'A'.
- 'M' only if 'a' itself is about walking/moving across the clip — if 'a' does not describe movement, 's' cannot be M either.
Raw JSON only, no extra text.

no_social.description: Modo compacto SIN estado social — solo descripción de acción. Usa {clip}/{id_map}/{example}/{keys}.
